payload.credit_html: Figure 7D of Eriksson et al. (2022)
payload.description_html: Life-sized 3D life restoration of a juvenlie Stenopterygius sp. based on MH 432. Description modified from caption in paper: "The final sculpture seen in oblique, right lateral view; note the distinctive predation wound (revealing the blubber), smaller scratches, and the minute teeth visible in the lower jaw. Also note that the boundary between the darker back and lighter belly is more gradual than in the earlier stage [of the process], and in concert with what could be deduced from the fossil specimen MH 432. For scale, the whole sculpture measures 1.6 m in length[...]"
